title: Akademiskkvart
description: Served as IT Project Leader for akademiskkvart.se, a second-hand student housing platform in Stockholm dedicated to providing fair rent to students. Led development efforts under the Stockholm Federation of Student Unions, focusing on platform improvements, feature development, and enhanced maintainability.

title: Doalot AB
description: Corporate website for Doalot AB, an IT management company. Built with Next.js and integrated with TinaCMS for streamlined content.

title: SL Departure Kiosk
description: Real-time public transport departure board for Stockholm's transit system. Designed specifically for display at a Student Union bar, providing live departure information on a kiosk-style interface.

title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer
description: Interactive visualization tool for various sorting algorithms, helping users understand algorithmic behavior through visual representations.

title: Systemvetardagen
description: Official website for Systemvetardagen, a premier career fair connecting IT students with industry opportunities.

title: num2kana
description: NPM package for converting Arabic numerals to Japanese writing systems (kanji, hiragana, and katakana). A practical tool for Japanese language learners to master number pronunciation and writing.

title: APK Web Extension
description: Chrome extension for systembolaget.se that calculates and displays APK (Alcohol Per Krona) values, enabling users to compare and sort products by value efficiency.

title: Game of Life
description: Implementation of Conway's Game of Life, the famous cellular automaton created by John Horton Conway in 1970.
